Lab result concept (uuid, mapping such as CIEL:790, or id) whose latest value for the patient is shown in the radiology queue for CT studies, as contrast may be given. No creatinine is shown when blank.

Link to the PACS viewer used for studies PACS has done but sent no image link for, as PACS only sends the link with the report. {accessionNumber} is replaced by the study's accession number, for example https://pacs-host/PACSAPI/Launch_Viewer?AccessionNumber={accessionNumber}. Anything in the link, including any user name and password, can be seen by users who can open it. No link is made when blank.

Facility service price id of the CD/DVD billed for each CT study, on the patient's private insurance policy (the insurance named in rwandaemr.autoCreateInsuranceType). Not billed when blank, or when the patient has no private policy with an open global bill.
Facility service price ids, separated by commas, each billed once for every CTA test (CT tests whose name starts with CTA), on the same insurance as the test. Not billed when blank.
ID, UUID, or mapping reference for the coded Service Requested concept whose answers are mapped to queue service points.
Location UUID, ID, or name of the Laboratory login-location service point. When blank, locations named Lab or containing Laboratory are treated as Laboratory.
Location UUID, ID, or name of the Radiology login-location service point. When blank, locations containing Radiology are treated as Radiology.
Location UUID, ID, or name of the Imaging login-location service point. When blank, locations containing Imaging are treated as Imaging.

Base URL for RHIP shared insurance integration API. Example: https://rhip-stag.moh.gov.rw/backend. When configured, RwandaEMR derives /insurance_integration/api/v2 eligibility, OTP, patient-types, patient-reception, approval-required-products, approval-request, and approval status endpoint URLs from this value unless the older full endpoint URL properties are configured.
Internal tracking value used to auto-generate Lab IDs. Stores the last date a Lab ID was generated and the next sequence value to use, in the format yyyy-MM-dd:N. Not meant to be edited manually.
Full RHIP approval-required products endpoint URL. Leave blank to derive from rwandaemr.insuranceIntegration.baseUrl.
Full RHIP approval request endpoint URL. Leave blank to derive from rwandaemr.insuranceIntegration.baseUrl.
Full RHIP approval status endpoint URL. Leave blank to derive from rwandaemr.insuranceIntegration.baseUrl.
Facility FOSA ID used for RHIP approval request and approval-required product calls.
